exposure: Gestational age (late preterm vs. early term)
cohort: 1,745 live births at a regional referral maternity hospital in Portugal in 2014 and 2015, with gestational age between 340/7 and 386/7 weeks.
finding: Late preterm infants (LPTI), compared to early term infants, had a higher risk of various morbidities including resuscitation, hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, transient tachypnea, eating difficulties, sepsis, longer hospital stays, and lower exclusive breastfeeding rates.
